title: Heavenly Flaky Mexican Chicken Sizzling Fajita Sizzle
description: Grassy, flaky, romantic Mexican (Norteño) dish featuring cherry tomatoes, simmer, shojin-friendly.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced red onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cherry tomatoes, cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the chicken breast to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetable mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
